items.title: Government Must Explain Apparent U-Turn On Vape Ban — MMA
items.summary: MMA demands Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad explain the proposal to exempt liquid nicotine from the Poisons List and reaffirm the government’s commitment to a nationwide vape ban, questioning an apparent U-turn after his pledge to ban vape. The post Government Must Explain Apparent U-Turn On Vape Ban — MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Protect Our Children: Stand Against Proposed Nicotine Exemption — WAFIQ
items.summary: WAFIQ has joined MyWatch in opposing the proposed exemption of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List, warning that legalising nicotine vape would expose more children to addiction and poisoning, amid rising youth vaping and drug-laced vape incidents. The post Protect Our Children: Stand Against Proposed Nicotine Exemption — WAFIQ appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Patients Skipping GPs For Private Hospitals Drive Up Medical Costs: APHM
items.summary: APHM honorary secretary Anwar Anis says patients bypassing GPs for private hospitals are driving up medical costs. Affin Bank says distrust of GP clinics and mandatory MCs for minor illnesses are fuelling unnecessary hospital visits and medication use. The post Patients Skipping GPs For Private Hospitals Drive Up Medical Costs: APHM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Liquid Nicotine Exemption Contradicts Planned Vape Ban: Bandar Kuching MP
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Kelvin Yii tells Putrajaya to be honest about whether it still intends to ban vape, after the Poisons Board reportedly approved a proposed exemption of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List. “The rakyat deserves an honest explanation.” The post Liquid Nicotine Exemption Contradicts Planned Vape Ban: Bandar Kuching MP appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sejarah Hitam Negaraku: Will Malaysia Repeat The Nicotine Betrayal? — MyWatch
items.summary: MyWatch warns the Madani government against renewing efforts to exempt nicotine vape from the Poisons List, saying a repeat of the 2023 decision would undermine the High Court’s ruling and betray public health, particularly children’s interests. The post Sejarah Hitam Negaraku: Will Malaysia Repeat The Nicotine Betrayal? — MyWatch appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Recruitment Alone Will Not Solve Sabah’s Doctor Shortage — MMA
items.summary: MMA says 750 permanent MO posts will not solve Sabah and Sarawak’s doctor shortages without better incentives and working conditions. Sabah saw 67% of replacement doctors from outside the state fail to report for duty. The post Recruitment Alone Will Not Solve Sabah’s Doctor Shortage — MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Beyond The Building: Examining Systems At Klinik Kesihatan Kuala Lumpur — A Concerned Health Care Staff Member
items.summary: Klinik Kesihatan Kuala Lumpur must review how specialists, gazettees, trainees, and medical officers are deployed to ensure fair workloads and clinical coverage. Clearer roles for nurses, assistant MOs, and support staff could also improve patient flow. The post Beyond The Building: Examining Systems At Klinik Kesihatan Kuala Lumpur — A Concerned Health Care Staff Member appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Make Lung Cancer A Notifiable Disease With Mandatory Reporting — LCNM
items.summary: Lung Cancer Network Malaysia urges the Health Ministry to require all public and private health care facilities to report new lung cancer cases, including clinical staging, to improve national cancer data and health care planning. The post Make Lung Cancer A Notifiable Disease With Mandatory Reporting — LCNM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Poisons Board Endorses Proposed Exemption Of Liquid Nicotine
items.summary: The Poisons Board has approved Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad’s proposal to exempt liquid nicotine from the Poisons List, paving the way to once again legalise nicotine vape via a minister’s order, even as Dr Dzul previously claimed he wanted to ban vape. The post Poisons Board Endorses Proposed Exemption Of Liquid Nicotine appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Malaysian Anaesthesiologist First Asian To Lead Global Pain Association
items.summary: Dr Mary Cardosa becomes the first Asian president of the International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) in its more than 50-year history, after decades of advancing pain management in Malaysia and Southeast Asia. The post Malaysian Anaesthesiologist First Asian To Lead Global Pain Association appeared first on CodeBlue .
